caption: A 120-man infantry block facing north is ordered to run to a point about 40 degrees east of north. A run order marches without a formed pivot, so its heading turns onto the march at once. The block's formation now stays where its men stand and swings round after the heading no faster than the men on its corners can walk, so the block sets off in good order and no man has to cross it. Before this fix the whole formation swung 40 degrees under the men in the same tick: six men's places jumped across the block, the men stood on average almost 3 m from their places, and the block marched off trailing them, a little slower than it does now.
